abilities.name: Food air-exposure trial
abilities.function: Lay whole units of your own food on open ground or an existing food surface to expose them to actual weather, optionally keeping a carried control from the same stack; inspect both decay trajectories; stop the trial.
abilities.costs: Study: 2 rounds. Start: inputStackId is the exact id of your own unspoiled, untreated berry or root stack (or food whose water composition is already represented); quantity whole units to expose; optional controlQuantity whole units of the same stack kept carried and reserved (together at most its whole units). Place at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your body radius, or on supportId, an existing food surface in reach. One round and 1 + 0.5 x quantity energy; all checks run before any charge; walking there is a separate navigate. Inspect: your open trial, within reach of the batch; one round, 0.2 energy. Stop: one round, no energy. Taking the food back uses pickup at its own cost. No tool, fuel, cutting or material is used or made.
abilities.effects: Start separates the units and lays them, unowned, on a ground footprint of 0.04 per unit (firm ordinary ground inside the world, not water, wet bank or waterlogged ground, unobstructed, nothing else lying there) or on the support, and gives them the world food water record (assumed water fraction root 0.75, berry 0.85). Every later round the existing rules apply: whole food loses no water; rain on the uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary rate for the temperature where the food lies and is never reset. The control ages normally while carried. So no dryness, preservation or safety status can be reached: they stay unverified; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; contamination is not assessed. Anyone may pick up food lying in the world: taking part reduces the batch, taking all ends the trial. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, decay at placement and now and per round for batch and control, their difference and rain on the batch, as an unverified personal record; water content is not measured. Spoilage under the existing rule or removal ends the trial; stop ends it and leaves the batch where it lies. Ending releases the control once; death ends it the same way. No refund, reward or comfort.

abilities.name: Thin-slice food drying trial
abilities.function: Cut one whole unit of your own root or berry into thin slices with a carried stone or flint edge, lay them in one thin layer on open ground or a food surface to air-dry under actual weather, optionally keeping a carried same-stack control; inspect; re-lay slices you picked up; stop.
abilities.costs: Study: 4 rounds, 0.5 energy each. prepare: inputStackId, your own unspoiled uncut root or berry stack with 1 + controlQuantity whole units (one unit per trial); toolId, your own carried whole stone or flint unit whose edge passes the world contact model (radius at most 0.0002, hardness 8+, not fractured or contaminated); a layer area of 5 x unit mass: a ground footprint centred at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your radius, or supportId, a food surface in reach at least that large. One round, 1.5 energy. inspect: in reach of the slices or carrying them; one round, 0.2 energy. resume: re-lays slices you picked up, same placement rules, no cutting; one round, 0.2 energy. stop: one round, no energy. All checks run before any charge; travel, gathering and pickup are separate. instrumentId is refused: no calibrated balance exists.
abilities.effects: Cutting keeps the unit's mass, water, nutrition, toxicity, decay and age; no offcut is represented; the edge gains no wear. Slices lie unowned as one sample with the world food water record (assumed water fraction root 0.75, berry 0.85; opening damage 1.1). Each round: water moves toward an equilibrium fraction 0.1 + 0.25 x air humidity (0.1-0.35) by at most 0.025 x area x (temperature - 5)/20 (0-2), so no gradient or warmth, no drying; rain on the uncovered layer adds 0.01 x rain x area; decay is the ordinary rate x 1.1 x (0.15 + 0.85 x water fraction/initial) (0.15-1.5), never reset. The control ages normally while carried. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, model decay of slices and control and their difference, visible shrinkage and wetness, and rain rounds as an unverified record; shrinkage does not measure water; spoilage, contamination, preservation and safety stay unverified. Anyone may take lying food: you taking the slices pauses the trial until resume; others taking them, spoilage, stop or death end it and release the control once. No refund or reward.

abilities.name: Shell compression opening
abilities.function: Press one whole unit of your own firm food, such as a nut, once between two rigid pressure surfaces to crack or split its outer layer, or inspect a food unit for its visible outer layer and interior state. Shell and contents cannot be separated in this world.
abilities.costs: Study: 2 rounds, 0.5 energy each. open: inputStackId, your own unreserved, unspoiled, untreated food stack with a whole unit, not soft (hardness above 1); pressureToolIds, one or two of your own whole inedible rigid sound items; with one, supportId is a solid unreserved object of represented material in reach; with two, the second rests on firm ground where you stand. One round, 1 energy, one unit per attempt. inspect: inputStackId, your own food stack; one round, 0.2 energy. Both need light: outdoors daylight above 0.1, indoors light above 0.1. separate is refused. All checks run before any charge; gather, pickup and travel are separate.
abilities.effects: Strength is hardness / 10. The load reaching the unit is the lower of the two surfaces’ strength x (1 - flexibility). If it is not above the unit’s strength the outer layer holds and nothing changes. Otherwise damage (load - strength) / strength is added and kept on the unit: at 1 its outer layer splits open and the interior is exposed, below 1 it stays cracked and closed and can be pressed again. A larger stack gives up one unit; the rest is unchanged. The surfaces carry no more than their own strength, so they are not damaged. The unit stays one whole carried unit with its mass, nutrition, origin, age and decay; shell and kernel parts, masses and yield are not represented, so nothing detaches and nothing is separated. Inspect records the visible outer layer, crack, whether the interior is exposed, visible deterioration (of the interior only once exposed) and quantity as an unverified approximate record; edibility, nutrition, toxins and safety stay unknown. No eating, refund or reward.

execution.progress: Each mode is one atomic round; a compression commits only when its round completes, and its crack or opening stays on the unit. No work, escrow or process persists.

abilities.name: Lever mass comparator
abilities.function: Assess, assemble, test, use, inspect or dismantle a lever comparator: your branch beam across a stone fulcrum, a fixed seat and your own sliding reference piece. Readings give sample mass as a fraction of the reference and before/after ratios, as intervals.
abilities.costs: Study: 4 rounds, 0.5 energy each. assess (materialIds, supportIds, referenceId, sampleId, or comparatorId): 1 round, 0.2; reports each requirement met or missing. assemble: materialIds [beam: your whole untreated branch unit; optional fulcrum: your whole stone or flint unit, set where you stand on firm ground], or supportIds [a solid stone or flint object in reach], and referenceId (your non-food piece that does not decay, at most 1 unit): 3 paid rounds of 0.5, continuing; resume with assemble and comparatorId. test, compare: one reading, 1 round, 0.2, at your comparator; reading empty or loaded (sampleId: your unreserved item, at most 1 unit); approach outward or inward. inspect: 1 round, 0.2. dismantle: 1 round, 0.2. Checks run before any charge; gather, pickup and travel are separate; no refund.
abilities.effects: Assumed: a branch is a uniform 1.1 m beam laid at its midpoint; positions are fractions of the half-beam from the fulcrum (+ toward the reference), read to 0.02; the seat is at -0.9. A reading slides the reference until the beam tips: torques of the actual masses against stiction 0.005 m x mass on the fulcrum, so outward and inward tips bracket a null range. A test (3+ empty and 3+ loaded readings of one sample, both directions each) passes if each set repeats within 0.04 and closes; a new test replaces it. compare on a tested comparator: an empty check, 3+ loaded readings of one sample (both directions) and a closing empty check within 0.04 of the test give an endpoint: sample/reference = (null - empty null)/0.9 as an interval. A later endpoint of the same sample (followed through pickup, cutting or exposure) and reference gives after/before: decrease or increase only if it excludes 1, else inconclusive; a wet stone or flint reference adds 1%, other wet references are inconclusive. Rain voids a test; a fulcrum losing firm ground damages it. Parts keep their ids and return on dismantle. No grams, water, safety or reward.

execution.progress: Assembly continues each round; an unworked round pauses it, keeping placed parts, and assemble with comparatorId resumes after rechecks. Other modes take one round.

Registry check: the ex19 scope installs only foundation-forest, foundation-open and the expression foundation, none of which implements continuing exposure; no earlier exposure or drying package could be reused unchanged (ex14 controlled-food-processing-trial@1 has learning 3 and states that no food moisture model exists, which is false here; ex14 air-dry-food@1 is a first release that reports the missing model; ex10 measured-food-preservation@1 and the collective-ex12 root and small drying packages are bound to their tray, sheet and root representations and scopes). Implemented: a new package food-air-exposure-trial@1 (scope long-ex19, built by a reusable foodAirExposurePackage(id, scope) factory) with a simplified but real mechanism over the installed general food water representation (foodWaterSurfaceArea, foodWaterExpose and foodWaterRead, with the unchanged ex10 exchange and its decay integration in the environment) and the existing paid-work and escrow helpers (workCreate, workPay, workAllocations, workReserve, workStop), openRemember and base pickup. Modes and costs: start (one round, 1 + 0.5 energy per exposed whole unit, paid through workPay) separates whole units of the actor's own unspoiled, untreated berry or root stack (or food whose water composition is already represented) and lays them unowned on a ground footprint within hand reach (default the actor's position) or on an existing reachable object marked as a food surface, after the representation's real checks (inside the world, firm ordinary ground rather than water, wet bank or waterlogged ground, unobstructed, one sample per surface); an optional controlQuantity from the same stack stays carried and reserved in ordinary handling; inspect (one round, 0.2 energy, within reach of the batch) records elapsed rounds, quantities, decay at placement and now, decay per round for batch and control, their difference and rain rounds as an unverified personal record; stop (one round, no energy) settles the trial, releases the control once and leaves the batch lying, to be taken back with base pickup at its own cost; every failed precondition throws before any charge, so nothing is spent. Effects: the batch receives the representation's water record and then follows its unchanged per-round rules: whole food loses no water, rain on the uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water, and decay continues at the ordinary rate for the temperature where the food lies and is never reset, so no dryness, preservation or safety status can be reached and all three stay unverified; nutrition, toxicity and solids are unchanged; food quantity is conserved across parent, batch and control. The trial record persists batch, control, placement, readings, rain rounds and last update, and exposure continues unattended without charge; partial removal by anyone reduces the batch, full removal or spoilage under the existing rule ends the trial and releases the control, and death ends it with the control dropped under the existing death rules while the batch stays exposed. Modes and costs: prepare (one round, 1.5 energy through workPay) takes one whole unit of the actor's own unspoiled, uncut, untreated root or berry stack (or food whose water composition is already represented), cuts it with toolId, the actor's own carried, unreserved whole stone or flint unit whose contact state under the world contact model passes the existing stone-edge predicate (contact-resistance index at least 8 and not below the food's, edge radius at most 0.0002, controlled contact, not fractured, not contaminated; food, plants, equipment and other materials are refused), and lays the slices in one thin layer either on a ground footprint centred within hand reach (default the actor's position) or on supportId, an existing reachable food-surface object at least as large as the layer; an optional controlQuantity of whole units from the same stack stays carried and reserved; inspect (one round, 0.2 energy, within reach of the slices or while carrying them); resume (one round, 0.2 energy) lays slices the owner had picked up again under the same placement checks without cutting them again; stop (one round, no energy) ends the trial, releases the control once and leaves the slices where they are; learning is 4 rounds at 0.5 energy each (learningEnergy); every refused request throws before any charge, so nothing is spent. Effects: the cut unit is separated through the escrow helpers and keeps its mass, water, solids, nutrition, toxicity, decay and age; it lies unowned as one sample with the food water record in its irreversible prepared state (opening damage 1.1), so each later round the unchanged existing exchange applies: water moves toward an equilibrium water fraction 0.1 + 0.25 x air humidity (clamped 0.1 to 0.35), by at most 0.025 x area x clamp((temperature - 5)/20, 0, 2) per round, never below that equilibrium, with vapour uptake when below it and no drying without a gradient or warmth; rain on the uncovered layer adds 0.01 x rain x area; vapour and rain go to the per-stack and world water ledgers; decay is the ordinary temperature rate times 1.1 x clamp(0.15 + 0.85 x water fraction / initial fraction, 0.15, 1.5) and is never reset, while the whole carried control ages at the ordinary rate; the stone keeps its mass and identity and its contact record is stored with no wear; food quantity is conserved across input, slices and control. Inspection records, as an unverified personal record, elapsed rounds, quantities, model decay readings at cutting and now and per round for slices and control and their difference (the air-exposure trial's trajectory semantics), visible shrinkage classed from the actual mass ratio, visible wetness from rain, visible spoilage, whether the surface is open or blocked and why, rain rounds and handling differences, and states that water and mass are not measured and that spoilage, contamination, preservation and safety are unverified; no water figure is reported. (1) Request: Moss asked for a personally learnable way to obtain or shape a carried stone or flint edge for thin-slice-food-drying-trial@1, with an actual assessment against its contact requirements (edge radius at most 0.0002, hardness at least 8, no fracture or contamination), having roots but no cutting tool and only a visible weathered stone source start-2-stone of unknown suitability. World Agent decision: develop (learning 3) a general shape-and-assess operation with modes select, shape and inspect, exact source or owned inputStackId and optional instrumentIds, whose initial executable modes are selection at a reachable source (one round, 0.2 energy, accessible loose candidates and visible defects only) and direct inspection (one round, 0.2 energy) in adequate light; shaping only for mechanically supported methods with real equipment and otherwise refused before charging; instruments only when acquired and calibrated; each property reported as observed, measured, failed or unverified; no certification, food safety, equipment or reward from registration. Implemented: cutting-edge-assessment@1 (factory cuttingEdgeAssessmentPackage, handler long.cutting-edge-assessment, study 3 rounds at 0.5 energy each). select names a reachable, visible, gatherable non-food material source by sourceId and costs one round and 0.2 energy; it reports the source, material, loose stock and, for one freshly gathered unit, each requirement of the existing stone-edge rule. inspect names one of the person's own carried, unreserved, non-food, non-equipment items of at least one whole unit and costs one round and 0.2 energy; it reports material, whole units, contact-resistance index, edge radius, wear, fracture, contamination and controlled contact under the world contact model, each with its required value, its evidence (visible, or world contact model value for the index), a status observed, model or failed, the list of unmet requirements and whether all are met. Both write an unverified personal record through openRemember and emit cutting-edge-candidates-observed or cutting-edge-inspected with view metadata (rock component, exact item, material, position, zero strokes and chips, edge outline not represented, measured false, no badge). shape is refused before any cost, as are any instrumentIds, unreachable or food sources, food, other people's or reserved items, darkness and energy below 0.2. Refused because the world cannot represent them: shaping, since the world has no fracture, flaking or sharpening law and its only stone contact law, the scratch stroke, wears an edge blunter by 0.00001 radius per stroke and detaches dust; instrument measurement, since no edge-measuring, hardness-reference or contamination-test instrument exists. (2) Request: Ivo asked for a minimal mechanical opening trial of a small owned hazelnut sample with inspection of the actual shell and contents, keeping usable contents separately if feasible, with no eating and no inference of safety or nutrition. World Agent decision: develop (learning 2) a general open-and-inspect operation for shelled material with exact inputStackId, one whole unit per attempt, optional pressureToolIds and supportId: one controlled low-force compression cycle between two checked sound, stable pressure surfaces with a stable lower support on firm ground, in adequate light (one round, 1 energy); inspection and separation (one round, 0.2 energy); separation into contents, shell and lost fragments by represented composition; conservation of mass, age and decay; no fabricated yield; no eating, nutrition, safety or reward. From a larger stack one whole unit is split off through workAllocations and workReserve and released at once, so the rest keeps its identity; a single unit keeps its own id.
